market.question: Will the highest temperature in Panama City be 30°C on May 2?

assessment.reasoning: Met Office forecast for Panama City May 2 shows max ~32°C; monthly high range 29-33°C. Probability of exactly 30°C bucket is ~15-20% given forecast lean is one bucket higher.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Afternoon convection could cap the daily high a bit lower than 32°C
